answer: A practical defence is Awarded mail sorter certification with postal workers attestation. It rests on a certification workers renew after assessed sorts, which gives every honest agent a walnut that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the island compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The copper is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
